scripts.fmt: bunx prettier --write src tests web/src web/index.html package.json docs/package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.fmt:check: bunx prettier --check src tests web/src web/index.html package.json docs/package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js .prettierrc.json
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:parity: bun run compile && BENTO_BIN=$PWD/dist/bento REQUIRE_BENTO_BIN=1 bun test tests/contract/parity_test.ts --timeout 120000
scripts.smoke:compiled: bun run compile && dist/bento version && dist/bento --stack ${BENTO_SMOKE_STACK:-/tmp/bento-smoke-$$} init && dist/bento --stack ${BENTO_SMOKE_STACK:-/tmp/bento-smoke-$$} render && dist/bento --stack ${BENTO_SMOKE_STACK:-/tmp/bento-smoke-$$} status
scripts.ci: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:integration
scripts.serve: bun run web:build && bun run src/main.ts serve
scripts.web:build: rm -rf web/dist && mkdir -p web/dist && bun build web/src/app.ts --target=browser --outfile=web/dist/app.js && cp web/index.html web/dist/index.html && cp web/src/app.css web/dist/app.css
scripts.compile: bun run web:build && mkdir -p dist && bun build --compile --asset=templates --asset=web/dist --outfile=dist/bento src/main.ts
scripts.compile:amd64: bun run web:build && mkdir -p dist && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --asset=templates --asset=web/dist --outfile=dist/bento-linux-amd64 src/main.ts
scripts.compile:arm64: bun run web:build && mkdir -p dist && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --asset=templates --asset=web/dist --outfile=dist/bento-linux-arm64 src/main.ts
